name: xiaomi-phone-bridge
description: Read selected documents from a personally owned Android phone only while its owner enables an active session.

interface.longDescription: Check the phone session, list selected documents, and read an explicitly selected text document. The owner can turn access off at any time.
interface.defaultPrompt: Проверь, доступен ли мой телефон, и перечисли выбранные файлы.
